background: Morgan Stanley is the holding company of a leading US investment bank whose earnings have shifted toward wealth and investment management alongside institutional securities, with a deposit franchise built on brokerage sweeps.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings sit below the bank's: A+ from Fitch after the upgrade on 4 Nov 2022, A- from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable. Consolidated capital is mixed against US peers: CET1 of 14.9% is in the top quarter against a 12.1% median, but leverage of 4.9% is in the bottom quarter against 5.8% and has fallen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2025. LCR of 129% is in the top quarter. The flagged news in the last 90 days is analyst calls and a court matter over diversity documents on 3 Sep 2026, none of it material to the balance sheet.
